in_sanskrit.name: शिंग
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Singh in Sanskrit originates from the Sanskrit word 'shing' which means 'lion'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'singha' which means 'lion'. The name Singh is often given to boys to signify strength, courage, and power, much like a lion.

in_hindi.name: सिंघ
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Singh in Hindi is 'सिंघ' (pronounced as 'siñg') which comes from the Sanskrit word 'शिंग' (shing) which means 'lion'. The name Singh is popular in India and is often given to boys to signify strength, courage, and power.

in_tamil.name: சிங்க
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Singh in Tamil is 'சிங்க' (pronounced as 'ciŋk') which can be derived from the Tamil word 'சிங்கப்படம்' (singappadam) which means 'lion fort'. The name Singh is popular among the Tamil community and is often given to boys to signify strength, courage, and protection.

in_telugu.name: శేశ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Singh in Telugu is 'శేశ్' (pronounced as 'śeś') which is derived from the Sanskrit word 'शिंग' (shing) which means 'lion'. The name Singh is popular in the Telugu community and is often given to boys to signify strength, courage, and power.

in_marathi.name: Singh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Singh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A person with the qualities of a lion, such as bravery, strength, and courage.
